name: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model (arXiv:2204.14198)
notes: arXiv:2204.14198. Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning. By Jean-Baptiste Alayrac et al. (DeepMind). Submitted 2022-04-29. Interleaves visual and text data for few-shot learning on arbitrary sequences of images/videos and text.
